vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1667 — reconcile lifecycle fixes update child planRefs

plan.title: reconcile:issues lifecycle fix rewrites child planRefs when parent moves

narratives.Description: `applyLifecycleFixes` in packages/core/src/intake/reconcile-issues.ts moves closed-issue vBRIEFs to completed/ but leaves child story vBRIEFs pointing at the old proposed/ path in planRef/items[].planRef. D4 validation then fails and blocks release.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. After moving a parent/epic vBRIEF in applyLifecycleFixes, scan vbrief/ for children referencing the old relative path and rewrite planRef to the new completed/ (or cancelled/) path.
2. Update propagateItemStatus or add rewriteChildPlanRefs helper; cover epic items[] back-links.
3. Add regression tests in packages/core/src/intake/intake-cli-and-branches.test.ts or reconcile-issues dedicated test.
4. CHANGELOG entry. Closes #1667.
narratives.UserStory: As a release operator running reconcile:issues --apply-lifecycle-fixes, I want child vBRIEF planRefs to follow moved parents, so that vbrief:validate passes without hand-editing six files.
narratives.Overview: v0.49.0 release cut blocker — dangling planRef after parent git mv.

items.title: Child planRefs rewritten on parent move

narrative.Acceptance: Given a parent moved proposed/X -> completed/X, when applyLifecycleFixes completes, then children referencing proposed/X have planRef updated to completed/X.
Given fixture parent+child vBRIEFs and closed upstream issue, when applyLifecycleFixes runs, then vbrief:validate reports no D4 planRef errors.
